title: Game characters and the franchise they belong to

franchise.match: Match each game character to the franchise they come from.
franchise.odd: Three of these characters are from {value}. Which one isn't?
franchise.reverse: Which of these characters is from {value}?

rows.label: Pikachu
rows.description: Pokémon species, mascot of the Pokémon franchise
rows.hook: is a yellow electric mouse with a lightning-bolt tail and red cheeks, and serves as the franchise mascot

rows.label: Lara Croft
rows.description: Tomb Raider protagonist character
rows.hook: is an athletic British archaeologist who explores ancient tombs and ruins, dual-wielding pistols

rows.label: Bulbasaur
rows.description: Pokémon species
rows.hook: is a green starter creature with a plant bulb growing on its back

rows.label: Link
rows.description: main character of The Legend of Zelda video games created by Shigeru Miyamoto
rows.hook: is a green-clad silent hero who wields a sword and shield to save a princess and a kingdom

rows.label: Samus Aran
rows.description: video game character
rows.hook: is an armored galactic bounty hunter whose helmet hides a woman, a twist that surprised early players

rows.label: Dr. Eggman
rows.description: fictional character from the Sonic franchise
rows.hook: is a mad scientist with a big mustache who builds robots to defeat a blue speedster

rows.label: Steve
rows.description: protagonist of Minecraft
rows.hook: is the default blocky player avatar in a sandbox game about mining and crafting

rows.label: Princess Peach
rows.description: fictional character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is a pink-gowned ruler of a mushroom-filled kingdom who is repeatedly kidnapped by a fire-breathing villain

rows.label: Rosalina
rows.description: fictional character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is a star-guarding guardian who lives in a comet observatory and mothers the star-like Lumas

rows.label: Bowser
rows.description: fictional character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is a spiky-shelled, fire-breathing king of the Koopas who keeps kidnapping a princess

rows.label: Mewtwo
rows.description: Pokémon species
rows.hook: is a genetically engineered psychic creature often called the strongest of its kind

rows.label: Ganon
rows.description: video game character
rows.hook: is a pig-like demon king and recurring final boss, whose human form is Ganondorf

rows.label: Knuckles the Echidna
rows.description: fictional character from the Sonic franchise
rows.hook: is a red, brawling guardian of a giant emerald who punches through enemies and can glide

rows.label: Yoshi
rows.description: fictonal character in the Mario video game franchise
rows.hook: is a green dinosaur companion who flutters, swallows enemies, and lays eggs

rows.label: Luigi
rows.description: fictional video game character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is a green-capped, easily frightened plumber who is the lanky younger twin brother of a famous hero

rows.label: Master Chief
rows.description: fictional character in the Halo video game series
rows.hook: is a green-armored super-soldier who fights an alliance of aliens in a sci-fi shooter series

rows.label: Cloud Strife
rows.description: protagonist of Final Fantasy VII
rows.hook: is a spiky-haired ex-soldier who swings an enormous buster sword in a classic role-playing game

rows.label: Mimikyu
rows.description: Pokémon species

rows.label: Princess Daisy
rows.description: fictional character from the Mario franchise
rows.hook: is an orange-clad tomboy ruler of Sarasaland, often paired with the green-capped brother

rows.label: Snorlax
rows.description: Pokémon species
rows.hook: is a huge, sleepy creature that blocks roads and does little but eat and nap

rows.label: GLaDOS
rows.description: fictional artificially intelligent computer system in the Portal series of video games
